北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 雾气朦胧，出门注意安全，气温微凉，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Foggy weather, drive safe. It's cool, remember to add layers!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨伴强风，体感湿冷。出门带伞，注意防风保暖。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and strong winds. It feels damp and cold, bring an umbrella and stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，湿度较大，出门记得带把伞，有备无患。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and humid. Bring an umbrella, just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 天气晴朗微风，体感舒适。外出记得防晒补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and breezy, feels great! Remember sun protection and hydration.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温较高，外出注意防晒，及时补充水分。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and warm. Protect from sun and stay hydrated.
深圳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 阵雨降临，体感稍凉。出门带伞，注意路滑和保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Showers expected, feels cooler. Bring an umbrella, watch for slippery roads.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，微风。湿度较大，注意防潮。体感舒适。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and breezy. High humidity, dress comfortably.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，湿度不低。出门添件薄外套，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and humid. Wear a light jacket, keep spirits high.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光正好，气温宜人。多外出走走，享受美好时光。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant. Go out and enjoy the beautiful weather.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，体感舒适。注意添衣，保持愉悦心情哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool, but comfortable. Remember to add layers, stay cheerful.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 多云好天气，气温宜人。微风拂面，适合户外活动。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and pleasant. Light breeze, perfect for outdoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 天气晴朗，但气温较低。出行务必多穿衣物，注意保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but cold. Dress warmly when going out to stay cozy.
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗微凉，早晚温差大。及时添衣，以防着凉感冒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Clear and cool. Big temperature swing, dress in layers to avoid colds.
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，气温舒适。微风宜人，适合户外活动。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies and pleasant. Gentle breeze, great for outdoor activities.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微热，风力较大。出门注意防晒和保湿。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and warm with strong winds. Remember sun protection and hydration.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗微风，气温舒适。适合户外散步，享受阳光。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Clear and breezy, pleasant temperature. Perfect for a walk, enjoy the sun.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，体感舒适。微风不燥，适合轻松出行。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and comfortable. Light breeze, suitable for a relaxed outing.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温较高。外出注意防晒补水，小心中暑。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and warm. Remember sun protection and hydration, prevent heatstroke.
漳浦.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨伴强风，体感较凉，出行记得带伞，注意防风保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and strong winds. It feels cool, bring an umbrella and stay warm.
